description: Dosto, yeh ek original grand cinematic orchestral score hai jiska naam "Beneath The Iron Peak" hai. Is track mein heavy brass, intense strings aur epic drums (taiko) ka use kiya gaya hai jo kisi bhi scene mein ek intense adventure aur suspense ki feel add kar deg
